sleep.title: Sleep and circadian health
sleep.optional_inputs: Sleep timing, duration, awakenings, schedule, light exposure, snoring, medication and caffeine
sleep.indicative_tests: Sleep diary; actigraphy when available; specialist sleep study when indicated
sleep.limitations: PVT and sleep sliders do not diagnose a sleep disorder
sleep.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

behavior.title: Behavioral and mental health
behavior.optional_inputs: Mood, anxiety, functioning, duration, stressors, support preferences; sensitive answers private
behavior.exam: Private clinician interview and mental status assessment
behavior.indicative_tests: Validated instrument only with exact version, scoring and use rights; targeted medical workup when indicated
behavior.limitations: A slider or journal cannot diagnose or exclude psychiatric illness
behavior.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

headache.title: Headache
headache.optional_inputs: Onset, abruptness, pattern, neurologic and visual symptoms, fever, exposure timing
headache.indicative_tests: Imaging and other targeted tests selected for concerning features; actual contemporaneous cabin exposure data where relevant
headache.limitations: Normal pulse or historical CO2 cannot exclude a dangerous cause
headache.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

rhythm.title: Heart rhythm
rhythm.optional_inputs: Palpitations, onset, duration, chest symptoms, fainting, medications
rhythm.indicative_tests: ECG; ambulatory monitoring for intermittent symptoms; selected electrolytes and thyroid testing
rhythm.limitations: Pulse rate is not an ECG
rhythm.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

acs.title: Acute coronary symptoms
acs.optional_inputs: Chest discomfort, associated breathlessness, onset, history
acs.indicative_tests: ECG and serial cardiac troponin in a capable medical setting; further imaging as selected
acs.limitations: Normal wearable readings cannot rule out acute coronary syndrome
acs.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

orthostatic.title: Orthostatic intolerance
orthostatic.optional_inputs: Gravity transition, position-related symptoms, fluids, medication, fainting
orthostatic.exam: Supervised position-related assessment only when gravity and condition permit
orthostatic.indicative_tests: Position-linked BP and pulse; ECG and other cause-directed testing
orthostatic.limitations: No standing test in microgravity; no unsupervised provocative challenge
orthostatic.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

vte.title: Venous thromboembolism
vte.optional_inputs: Unilateral swelling, pain, breathlessness, prior clot, risk factors
vte.indicative_tests: Vascular ultrasound; pulmonary imaging and selected laboratory tests according to clinical pathway
vte.limitations: Symptoms and pulse cannot diagnose or rule out a clot
vte.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

shock.title: Shock and perfusion
shock.optional_inputs: Bleeding, injury, infection, cardiac symptoms, time course
shock.exam: Immediate clinical airway, breathing, circulation and consciousness assessment
shock.indicative_tests: Serial vital signs; ECG, ultrasound, hemoglobin, lactate and other cause-directed tests when available
shock.limitations: Do not wait for tests or repeat readings before urgent human response
shock.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

resp.title: Respiratory infection
resp.optional_inputs: Cough, sputum, fever, breathlessness, contacts, duration
resp.indicative_tests: Temperature and SpO2 as supporting observations; pathogen tests; chest imaging if indicated
resp.limitations: Normal SpO2 does not exclude infection
resp.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

airway.title: Airway or respiratory emergency
airway.optional_inputs: Breathing difficulty, witnessed obstruction, responsiveness, exposure
airway.indicative_tests: Respiratory rate, SpO2, ECG and blood gas or imaging when indicated and available
airway.limitations: Data collection must not delay urgent response
airway.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

allergy.title: Allergic presentations
allergy.optional_inputs: Exposure, timing, rash, swelling, breathing and circulatory symptoms
allergy.indicative_tests: Clinical diagnosis; selected later allergy investigation by clinician
allergy.limitations: No deliberate exposure or home challenge to test an allergy
allergy.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

toxic.title: Toxic exposure
toxic.optional_inputs: Agent, route, amount if known, duration, cabin events, co-exposed people
toxic.indicative_tests: Agent-specific laboratory testing; co-oximetry for suspected combustion-related CO exposure; environmental measurements
toxic.limitations: Ordinary pulse oximetry cannot establish absence of carbon monoxide poisoning
toxic.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

pressure.title: Pressure and decompression events
pressure.optional_inputs: Pressure profile, suit event, EVA timing, symptoms, prior exposure
pressure.indicative_tests: Clinical assessment tied to exposure; targeted imaging or physiologic tests for complications
pressure.limitations: No single app test excludes decompression illness; no self-provocation
pressure.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

radiation.title: Radiation exposure
radiation.optional_inputs: Dosimeter, event, location, shielding, onset of symptoms
radiation.indicative_tests: Dosimetry; CBC with differential and serial assessment as clinically selected; specialist biodosimetry
radiation.limitations: Camera and symptom timing alone cannot estimate a reliable absorbed dose
radiation.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

thermal.title: Thermal illness and burns
thermal.optional_inputs: Heat or chemical event, duration, affected area, pain, functional change
thermal.exam: Clinical assessment of extent, depth and systemic effects
thermal.indicative_tests: Appropriate temperature measurement and cause-directed laboratory tests; photographs only with consent
thermal.limitations: Photo is documentation, not an automatic burn-depth diagnosis
thermal.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

dust.title: Dust exposure
dust.optional_inputs: Surface/habitat event, route, duration, eye, skin and respiratory symptoms
dust.indicative_tests: Environmental particle measurement if available; eye or respiratory testing as indicated
dust.limitations: Record suspected exposure separately from measured dose
dust.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

gi.title: Digestive symptoms
gi.optional_inputs: Stool frequency/appearance, vomiting, pain, bleeding, meals, fluids, medications
gi.indicative_tests: Targeted stool, blood or endoscopic investigation according to presentation
gi.limitations: A symptom diary cannot exclude serious abdominal disease
gi.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

abdomen.title: Acute abdominal presentations
abdomen.optional_inputs: Pain location/onset, vomiting, bowel movements, fever, pregnancy possibility when relevant
abdomen.indicative_tests: Condition-directed ultrasound/CT and laboratory workup; pregnancy testing when relevant
abdomen.limitations: No automated abdominal diagnosis from symptom location
abdomen.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

uti.title: Urinary infection
uti.optional_inputs: Urinary pain, frequency, fever, flank pain, retention, relevant anatomy
uti.indicative_tests: Urinalysis and urine culture; other testing for systemic illness or obstruction
uti.limitations: Urine color alone cannot diagnose infection
uti.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

bladder.title: Bladder emptying and continence
bladder.optional_inputs: Last void, volumes, urgency, leakage, medications, neurologic symptoms
bladder.indicative_tests: Postvoid residual with bladder ultrasound; urinalysis and further evaluation as indicated
bladder.limitations: Absence of a bladder scanner remains an assessment gap
bladder.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

stones.title: Kidney stones
stones.optional_inputs: Flank pain, urine changes, fever, prior stones, fluid history
stones.indicative_tests: Urine and blood tests; ultrasound or CT as appropriate
stones.limitations: History alone cannot confirm a stone or exclude infected obstruction
stones.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

repro.title: Reproductive and gynecologic health
repro.optional_inputs: Relevant anatomy, bleeding, pain, menstrual history, pregnancy possibility, medications; private
repro.indicative_tests: Pregnancy testing, ultrasound and targeted laboratory or microbiology tests when indicated
repro.limitations: Pregnancy is not a disease; relevance cannot be inferred from gender/name
repro.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

eye.title: Eye symptoms
eye.optional_inputs: Acuity change, pain, flashes/floaters, chemical/trauma exposure, laterality
eye.indicative_tests: Acuity, slit-lamp/fluorescein, fundus, pressure or imaging as condition requires
eye.limitations: Consumer camera is not a substitute for specialist eye equipment
eye.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

sans.title: Spaceflight-associated neuro-ocular changes
sans.optional_inputs: Visual change, near/far difficulty, mission duration, prior eye baseline
sans.indicative_tests: Acuity, refraction, fundus examination, OCT and ocular ultrasound as indicated
sans.limitations: No SANS diagnosis from face video or headache alone
sans.equipment: OCT; fundus camera; eye examination equipment
sans.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

ent.title: Ear, nose and mouth symptoms
ent.optional_inputs: Pain, obstruction, discharge, bleeding, pressure change, hearing or swallowing change
ent.indicative_tests: Condition-directed tests; imaging or specialist review when indicated
ent.limitations: Webcam pictures cannot replace otoscopy or a full examination
ent.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

hearing.title: Hearing
hearing.optional_inputs: Sudden/gradual change, laterality, tinnitus, noise exposure, baseline
hearing.indicative_tests: Calibrated audiometry; tympanometry or other specialist studies if indicated
hearing.limitations: Laptop volume is not calibrated audiometry
hearing.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

dental.title: Dental
dental.optional_inputs: Tooth/location, pain, swelling, fever, trauma, lost restoration
dental.indicative_tests: Dental imaging and pulp/periodontal assessment as indicated
dental.limitations: Photo intake cannot rule out deep infection
dental.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

skin.title: Skin and superficial wounds
skin.optional_inputs: Site, evolution, itch/pain, fever, contact, wound mechanism
skin.indicative_tests: Swab/culture, fungal testing or biopsy only as indicated
skin.limitations: Images support documentation; no autonomous image diagnosis
skin.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

injury.title: Injury and dislocation
injury.optional_inputs: Mechanism, site, function, bleeding, numbness, timing
injury.indicative_tests: Imaging selected for injury; internal trauma may need ultrasound/CT and labs
injury.limitations: No self-reduction, invasive examination or forced movement instructions
injury.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

fracture.title: Possible fracture
fracture.indicative_tests: X-ray or CT according to site and clinical concern
fracture.limitations: No movement challenge to exclude fracture
fracture.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

neuro.title: Acute neurologic presentations
neuro.optional_inputs: Last known well, new weakness, speech/vision change, seizure, trauma, medications
neuro.indicative_tests: Glucose, CT/MRI, ECG and cause-directed tests; EEG for selected seizure evaluation
neuro.limitations: No normal vital sign or camera reading rules out neurologic emergency
neuro.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

neuropathy.title: Neuropathy
neuropathy.optional_inputs: Distribution, onset, compression/exposure, strength and sensory changes
neuropathy.indicative_tests: Selected nerve conduction/EMG, imaging and laboratory tests
neuropathy.limitations: Symptom mapping is not a localization diagnosis
neuropathy.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

vestibular.title: Motion and vestibular symptoms
vestibular.optional_inputs: Gravity transition, movement trigger, nausea, hearing change, neurologic symptoms
vestibular.indicative_tests: Clinical examination; specialist vestibular or imaging tests if indicated
vestibular.limitations: No fall-risk provocative test; microgravity changes test applicability
vestibular.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

msk.title: Musculoskeletal pain
msk.optional_inputs: Site, loading, trauma, function, swelling, neurologic symptoms
msk.indicative_tests: Imaging or laboratory studies when indicated; strength measurements with suitable equipment
msk.limitations: Exercise minutes do not measure strength or bone density
msk.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

sepsis.title: Possible systemic infection
sepsis.optional_inputs: Infection symptoms, time course, confusion, urine output, relevant history
sepsis.indicative_tests: Cultures, blood count, lactate, organ-function tests and source-directed investigation
sepsis.limitations: Do not use a normal temperature or incomplete score to rule out sepsis
sepsis.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

overdose.title: Medication or substance exposure
overdose.optional_inputs: Substance, amount/time if known, co-ingestants, responsiveness, breathing
overdose.indicative_tests: ECG, glucose, respiratory monitoring and substance-specific tests as appropriate
overdose.limitations: Medication log does not establish dose actually taken or toxicity
overdose.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

hydration.title: Hydration and nutrition
hydration.optional_inputs: Intake, losses, appetite, EVA, urine trend, exercise and mass context
hydration.indicative_tests: Mass trends with appropriate device; electrolytes, renal function and other selected labs
hydration.limitations: Intake diary and urine color cannot independently diagnose dehydration
hydration.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

bone.title: Bone health
bone.optional_inputs: Fractures, mission duration, loading exercise, medications and nutrition
bone.indicative_tests: DXA bone mineral density and selected laboratory evaluation
bone.limitations: Exercise adherence cannot establish preserved bone density
bone.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

endocrine.title: Endocrine and metabolic disorders
endocrine.optional_inputs: Symptoms, known condition, medication, nutrition, relevant history
endocrine.indicative_tests: Condition-specific hormones/metabolic tests; glucose or HbA1c as appropriate
endocrine.limitations: No universal hormone panel or diagnosis from fatigue
endocrine.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

hematology.title: Hematologic disorders
hematology.indicative_tests: CBC/differential and cause-directed coagulation, iron or other studies
hematology.limitations: Blood count findings require clinical interpretation
hematology.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

cancer.title: Possible neoplasm
cancer.optional_inputs: Organ-specific symptoms, history, duration, relevant screening history
cancer.indicative_tests: Organ-specific imaging, endoscopy and/or pathology as indicated
cancer.limitations: Do not create a universal cancer screen or tumor-marker battery
cancer.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

renal.title: Other renal conditions
renal.optional_inputs: Urine changes, edema, history, medication, fluids
renal.indicative_tests: Renal function, urine studies and imaging selected for condition
renal.limitations: No renal diagnosis from wearable data
renal.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

cardiac.title: Other cardiovascular conditions
cardiac.optional_inputs: Symptoms, exertion, history, medication, prior investigations
cardiac.indicative_tests: ECG, echocardiography, BP or other condition-specific studies
cardiac.limitations: Single BP reading is not a general cardiovascular diagnosis
cardiac.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

rheum.title: Inflammatory and connective-tissue conditions
rheum.optional_inputs: Joint/systemic symptoms, time course and history
rheum.indicative_tests: Condition-directed laboratory testing and imaging; selected fluid studies
rheum.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

liver.title: Hepatic and biliary disorders
liver.indicative_tests: Liver chemistry, targeted infection testing and imaging as indicated
liver.limitations: No liver diagnosis from symptoms alone
liver.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

lung.title: Other pulmonary conditions
lung.indicative_tests: Spirometry, imaging, blood gas or specific tests as indicated
lung.limitations: SpO2 does not measure ventilation or PaCO2
lung.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

vascular.title: Other vascular conditions
vascular.indicative_tests: Appropriate vascular imaging and targeted laboratory studies
vascular.limitations: No pulse-only exclusion of vascular disease
vascular.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

chronicgi.title: Other digestive disorders
chronicgi.optional_inputs: Site, bowel changes, duration, weight/mass trend and history
chronicgi.indicative_tests: Condition-specific blood/stool testing, imaging or endoscopy
chronicgi.limitations: No routine invasive test merely because a condition is in the catalog
chronicgi.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

other.title: Specialist review / catalog item
other.optional_inputs: Narrative concern, onset, function and prior relevant reports
other.exam: Condition-specific clinician assessment to be specified
other.indicative_tests: No generic test panel: condition-level pathway requires clinical authoring
other.limitations: Catalog presence establishes coverage for recording and referral only; no diagnostic workflow yet
other.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

neurochronic.title: Other neurologic conditions
neurochronic.optional_inputs: Present concern, time course, function, relevant history and existing reports
neurochronic.indicative_tests: Clinical neurologic examination; MRI, electrophysiology or targeted laboratory tests according to the suspected condition
neurochronic.limitations: No neurologic diagnosis from symptom mapping or camera vitals
neurochronic.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol

palliative.title: Supportive and palliative care
palliative.optional_inputs: Present concern, time course, function, relevant history and existing reports
palliative.indicative_tests: Assessment of symptoms, function, preferences, care goals and support needs; tests only if they would change goal-concordant care
palliative.limitations: A care approach, not a disease requiring a screening test
palliative.review_status: Planning synthesis; not a reviewed clinical protocol
